verdict.rationale: Poke's docs say external services such as GitHub, CI/CD or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens, and that Recipes let users set up automations. Neither source shows how a user defines rules (conditions → actions) or which event types are supported, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented rule or trigger-definition interface, a list of supported event sources and conditions, examples of automatic actions fired by events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Services like GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, or monitoring tools can trigger Poke when something happens.
All new and existing users can use Poke Recipes to easily set up automations and integrations
